title: Three Vegan Grilled Cheese Builds: 5 Minutes, 50 Minutes, and 5 Hours
summary: Goodful’s video presents a side‑by‑side exploration of vegan grilled cheese at three different time commitments. Host Merle guides viewers through a rapid 5‑minute tofu‑based cheese, a 50‑minute cashew‑based cheese with agar agar and tapioca for melt, and a full 5‑hour production that includes homemade bread, roasted-tomato soup, and two vegan cheeses (smoked gouda and cheddar). The episode emphasizes sustainability (cloth-wrapped tofu pressing), plant-based flavor boosters (nutritional yeast, miso, lemon juice, herbs), and meltability achieved with vegan thickeners (agar agar, tapioca starch, kappa carrageenan). It also features practical kitchen techniques (toasting bread, using a Dutch oven, immersion blender for soup) and a simple side salad to accompany the final sandwich. The video blends quick execution with a from-scratch offer, ending with tasting notes and encouragement to try the homemade approach.
topics: apple cider vinegar in vegan cheese

sections.title: 5-Minute Vegan Grilled Cheese
concepts: nutritional yeast and apple cider vinegar flavoring
toasted bread assembly with tomato slice
sections.description: Merle demonstrates a rapid, five-minute vegan cheese using tofu as a base. Tofu is wrapped and pressed with a book to drain moisture, then mixed in a food processor with nutritional yeast, apple cider vinegar, sugar, coconut oil, and salt. Toasted bread serves as the bread vehicle, and the mixture is spread with added chives and herbs to emulate a traditional grilled cheese, finished with tomato slices for brightness.

sections.title: 50-Minute Vegan Grilled Cheese
concepts: blending with lemon juice, garlic powder, turmeric
tapioca starch and agar agar as thickener/binder
avocado salad dressing with lemon, olive oil, parsley
sections.description: This segment moves to a more traditional cheese texture using a carrot–cashew base, which is boiled, blended with flavorings, and thickened with tapioca starch and agar agar to achieve a melt. The cheese is spread into a pan to set, then plated with a fresh avocado salad dressing. The result highlights melt, stretch, and a more cheese-like flavor profile relative to the 5-minute version.

sections.title: 5-Hour Gourmet Vegan Grilled Cheese (From-Scratch Build)
concepts: paralleling soup preparation while dough proofs
smoked gouda and cheddar vegan cheeses
arborio rice to enrich soup creaminess
Dutch oven preheating and bread baking at 450°F
sections.description: This full‑build section covers a from‑scratch approach: a yeast dough that rises and proofs, a roasted tomato soup thickened with arborio rice, and two distinct vegan cheeses (smoked gouda and cheddar) built with cashews, miso, roasted peppers, turmeric, and stabilizers like tapioca starch and kappa carrageenan. The dough is proofed twice and baked in a preheated Dutch oven, with an immersion blender finishing the soup. The video culminates in assembling a gourmet grilled cheese and tasting the final product.
